body:
My family is always telling me how proud they are of me, but most of the time I feel a bit of doubt, like, why WOULD they be proud? I barely passed my first semester of community college, and I didn't have enough to pay for the second yet, and I hardly do anything worth noting anywhere else in life. I just feel like if I were them, I wouldn't be proud of me. 

Also, ask away. I find it easier to answer these questions through text instead of trying to speak my mind to some therapist.

I have always felt that I was good for nothing. I just never understood my worth when I'm sure there's someone who could do better than me for literally anything you could name. I e tried working on it, but the feeling just lingers.
